title: Final Expression for n
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct analytical expression for the photon number density n in terms of T and universal constants.

title: Integral Representation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and represent the dimensionless integral I in their expression for n.

title: Estimation of n
description: Essential Criteria: The student must estimate the value of n for T = 3 K and provide a numerical answer within two orders of magnitude.

title: Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the universal constants k_B, h, and c in their calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that the units in their final answer for n are consistent and correctly expressed in cm^-3.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in their calculations.
